chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about salat (prayer) on qār.
So he said: “There is no issue with it.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, who gives the ruling.
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: Salat (prayer), the ritual act being discussed.
key_terms.الْقَارِ: Qār, meaning bitumen or tar, the surface/material asked about.
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: An expression indicating there is no problem or objection, i.e. permissibility.
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ: A narrator who asked the Imam about the ruling.

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on qār?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) on qār. Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no issue with it, indicating permissibility in this matter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.836 - Muawiya ibn Ammar asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about praying on qār (bitumen or tar).
The Imam said: "There is no issue with it”.
